titulo: An AI helped crack a 35-year-old code challenge 🔐
descripcion: In September 2026, RSA-260 and then RSA-896 were factored with help from AI agents. Your bank is still safe, here's why. Full story in the linked video.

escenas.texto: In September, a 260 digit number that had resisted everyone since nineteen ninety one was finally split into two primes.
The software that did it was built by an AI agent called Devin, running on spare GPUs, for about four hundred thousand dollars.
Sixteen days later, a researcher at Anthropic used Claude on up to two thousand GPUs and broke the record again.
So is your bank in danger? No. A real twenty forty eight bit key is about ninety one billion times harder.
The real threat is quantum computers, and RSA's retirement date is already set. Watch the full video, it's linked right here.
